highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 delivers compiler XML documentation alongside packages and refreshes the bundled m154 renderer.
highlights_body: The release also keeps HarfBuzzSharp bindings synchronized with the bundled native source and improves generated interop maintenance.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled Skia m154 renderer with the latest upstream corrections, including buffer-upload fixes.
Packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation so IDE tooltips and API references can use the managed API comments directly.
Generated P/Invoke declarations are organized by type, making the native interop surface easier to maintain while preserving the managed API.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz bindings follow bundled native source
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp binding generation now follows the same pinned HarfBuzz source used to build the bundled native library, keeping supported declarations synchronized.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Scoped the native HarfBuzzSharp conversion-warning suppression to satisfy package analysis
